# Applications

Pluggable applications are available. Example: the [debate app](https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-apps/debate)

To install an app clone the apps repository at the same level as the ui repository:

```bash
cd agent-smith-env
git clone https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-apps.git
tree -d -L 1
├── agent-smith-ui
└── agent-smith-apps
```

Run the install app script:

```bash
cd agent-smith-ui
node scripts/installapp.js debate
```

This will install the app and configure the frontend to use it.
